mapper.select: /** [sql-restore.xml] RestoreMapper.getRestoreList **/ SELECT A.ST11_COMPANY, /* 회사 */ A.ST11_FACTORY, /* 공장 */ A.ST11_HNO, /* 반납요청서번호 */ A.ST11_NO, /* 반납요청상세번호 */ A.ST11_SEQ, /* 상세순번 */ A.ST11_CODE, /* 품목코드 */ A.ST11_LOT, /* 로트번호 */ A.ST11_QTY, /* 반납수량 */ A.ST11_STOK, /* 보관장소 */ A.ST11_DISTRICT AS ST11_DIST, /* 구역 */ A.ST11_INDTE, /* 등록일자 */ A.ST11_EMPNO, /* 등록자 사번 */ A.ST11_UPDTE, /* 수정일자 */ A.ST11_UPD_EMPNO, /* 수정자 사번 */ C.CM08_NAME, /* 품목명 */ C.CM08_OPUNT, /* 출고단위 */ C.CM08_GBN /* 품목구분 */ , (SELECT CM15_NAME FROM TB_CM_15 WHERE CM15_COMPANY = A.ST11_COMPANY AND CM15_FACTORY = A.ST11_FACTORY AND CM15_CODE = A.ST11_STOK AND ROWNUM < 2 ) AS ST11_STOK_NAME /* 창고명 */ , (SELECT CM16_NAME FROM TB_CM_16 WHERE CM16_COMPANY = A.ST11_COMPANY AND CM16_FACTORY = A.ST11_FACTORY AND CM16_CODE = A.ST11_DISTRICT AND ROWNUM < 2 ) AS ST11_DISTRICT_NAME /* 구역명 */ , (SELECT CM05_NAME FROM TB_CM_05 WHERE CM05_COMPANY = c.CM08_COMPANY AND CM05_FACTORY = c.CM08_FACTORY AND CM05_VALUE = c.CM08_OPUNT AND CM05_CODE = 'C005' ) AS cm08_opunt_name /* 출고단위명 */ , NVL(E.ST02_QTY, 0) AS ST02_QTY /* 출고수량 */ , TO_CHAR(NVL(E.ST02_DAT, ''), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS ST02_DAT /* 입고일자 */ , A.ST11_LOT_SEQ FROM TB_ST_11 A /* 반납관리 Detail 테이블 */ INNER JOIN TB_ST_10 B /* 반납관리 Master 테이블 */ ON A.ST11_COMPANY = B.ST10_COMPANY AND A.ST11_FACTORY = B.ST10_FACTORY AND A.ST11_HNO = B.ST10_NO INNER JOIN TB_CM_08 C /* 품목 테이블 */ ON A.ST11_COMPANY = C.CM08_COMPANY AND A.ST11_FACTORY = C.CM08_FACTORY AND A.ST11_CODE = C.CM08_CODE LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_ST_02 E ON E.ST02_COMPANY = A.ST11_COMPANY AND E.ST02_FACTORY = A.ST11_FACTORY AND E.ST02_RENO = A.ST11_NO WHERE A.ST11_COMPANY = #{company} AND A.ST11_FACTORY = #{factory} AND A.ST11_HNO = #{st10No}

/** [sql-restore.xml] RestoreMapper.getRestoreMgmtInfo **/ SELECT ST10_COMPANY, /* 회사 */ ST10_FACTORY, /* 공장 */ ST10_NO, /* 반납요청서번호 */ TO_CHAR(ST10_DAT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS ST10_DAT, /* 반납요청일자 */ ST10_SEQ, /* 순번 */ ST10_DEPT, /* 부서코드 */ ST10_RMK, /* 사유 */ ST10_YN, /* 승인여부 */ ST10_INDTE, /* 등록일자 */ ST10_EMPNO, /* 등록자사번 */ ST10_N_RMK /* 미승인사유 */ FROM TB_ST_10 /* 반납관리 MASTER */ WHERE ST10_COMPANY = #{company} AND ST10_FACTORY = #{factory} AND ST10_NO = #{st10No}
mapper.insert:
/** [sql-restore.xml] RestoreMapper.saveOfProductionInput **/
SELECT NVL(MAX(ST02_SEQ)+1,1) AS st02_seq FROM TB_ST_02 WHERE 1 = 1
AND ST02_DAT BETWEEN TO_DATE(#{st02Dat}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND TO_DATE(#{st02Dat}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 0.99999
AND ST02_DAT BETWEEN TRUNC(SYSDATE) AND TRUNC(SYSDATE) + 0.99999
AND ST02_COMPANY = #{st11Company} AND ST02_FACTORY = #{st11Factory}
/* saveOfProductionInput - 반납입고 등록 */ MERGE INTO TB_ST_02 T1 USING DUAL ON ( ST02_COMPANY = #{st11Company} AND ST02_FACTORY = #{st11Factory} AND ST02_RENO = #{st11No} ) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET ST02_QTY = #{st02Qty} , ST02_STOK = #{st11Stok} , ST02_DIST = #{st11Dist} , ST02_INDTE = SYSDATE WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( ST02_COMPANY, ST02_FACTORY, ST02_NO, ST02_DAT, ST02_SEQ, ST02_CODE, ST02_LOT, ST02_LOT_SEQ, ST02_GBN, ST02_IPUNT, ST02_OPUNT, ST02_IPQTY, ST02_QTY, ST02_STOK, ST02_DIST, ST02_INDTE, ST02_EMPNO, ST02_QRCODE, ST02_RENO ) VALUES ( #{st11Company}, #{st11Factory},
CONCAT(REPLACE(#{st02Dat},'-',''),LPAD(#{st02Seq},5,'0')),
CONCAT(TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD'),LPAD(#{st02Seq},5,'0')),
TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{st02Dat},'-',''), 'YYYYMMDD'),
TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD'),
#{st02Seq}, #{st11Code}, #{st11Lot}, #{st11LotSeq}, 'RE', /* 반납 - st02_gbn */ #{cm08Ipunt}, #{cm08Opunt}, #{st02Qty}, /* st02_ipqty Qty 동일 사용 */ #{st02Qty}, /* st02_qty */ #{st11Stok}, #{st11Dist}, SYSDATE, /* st02_indte */ #{st11Empno}, #{qrcode}, #{st11No} /* st02_reno */ )
mapper.select: /** [sql-restore.xml] RestoreMapper.getProductInfo **/ SELECT A.CM08_ORDQTY, A.CM08_COMPANY, A.CM08_FACTORY, A.CM08_CODE, A.CM08_GBN, A.CM08_DGBN, A.CM08_NAME, A.CM08_MODELNUM, A.CM08_ENAME, A.CM08_IPUNT, A.CM08_OPUNT, A.CM08_CONVERT, A.CM08_NAP, A.CM08_MINQTY, A.CM08_AVGQTY, A.CM08_AVGYN, A.CM08_CERT, A.CM08_RMK, A.CM08_FIFO, A.CM08_IQC, A.CM08_AVAILABLE, A.CM08_LOT_YN, A.CM08_INPUTYN, A.CM08_OUTPUTYN, A.CM08_BARCODE, A.CM08_CARTYPE, A.CM08_YNDTE, A.CM08_RI_DTE, A.CM08_RELEASE, A.CM08_INPUT, A.CM08_OVER, A.CM08_ABN, A.CM08_CHANGE_QTY, A.CM08_RATIOMT, A.CM08_RATIOMT_ID, A.CM08_MT, A.CM08_MT_ID, A.CM08_ORDER, A.CM08_PRFTIME, A.CM08_RATIO_ID, A.CM08_RATIO_STD, TO_CHAR(A.CM08_INDTE,'YYYY-MM-DD') AS CM08_INDTE, TO_CHAR(A.CM08_UPDTE,'YYYY-MM-DD') AS CM08_UPDTE, A.CM08_EMPNO, A.CM08_PROD_CONVERT, A.CM08_MOQ, A.CM08_CMF, COALESCE(B.TOTAL_QTY - A.CM08_ORDQTY,0) AS STOCK_QTY, A.CM08_CUS, C.CM01_NAME AS CM08_CUST_NAME, A.CM08_VAPACK_YN AS CM08_VAPACK_YN, A.CM08_MES_YN AS CM08_MES_YN FROM TB_CM_08 A LEFT JOIN (SELECT ST01_CODE, ST01_COMPANY, ST01_FACTORY, SUM(B.ST01_QTY) AS TOTAL_QTY FROM TB_ST_01 b GROUP BY B.ST01_COMPANY, B.ST01_FACTORY, B.ST01_CODE) B ON A.CM08_FACTORY = ST01_FACTORY AND A.CM08_COMPANY = ST01_COMPANY AND A.CM08_CODE = ST01_CODE LEFT JOIN TB_CM_01 C ON A.CM08_COMPANY = C.CM01_COMPANY AND A.CM08_FACTORY = C.CM01_FACTORY AND A.CM08_CUS = C.CM01_CODE WHERE 1=1 AND CM08_CODE = #{cm08Code} AND CM08_COMPANY = #{company} AND CM08_FACTORY = #{factory}
